title: OmuRice
attribution: Recipe adapted from Food Fusion (foodfusion.com). Not an official Food Fusion product.

items.raw: Namak (Salt) ¼ tsp or to taste
Kali mirch powder (Black pepper powder) ½ tsp or to taste
Safed mirch powder (White pepper powder) ½ tsp
Chinese salt ¼ tsp (optional or you may skip this)
Hara pyaz (Green onion) finely chopped ½ Cup
Namak (Salt) ¼ tsp or to taste

steps.instruction: In wok,add oil,butter and let it melt.
steps.romanUrdu: Karhai mein oil aur makhan dal ker melt ker lein.
Lehsan dal ker ache tarhan mix karein.

steps.instruction: Add chicken boneless cubes and mix well until changes color.
steps.romanUrdu: Chicken boneless cubes dal dein aur rang tabdeel hunay tak ache trahan mix ker lein.

steps.instruction: Add salt,black pepper powder,garlic powder,white pepper powder,chinese salt,hot sauce and mix well.
steps.romanUrdu: Namak,kali mirch powder,lehsan powder,safed mirch powder,chinese salt aur hot sauce dal ker ache tarhan mix ker lein.

steps.instruction: Add tomato ketchup and mix well.
steps.romanUrdu: Tomato ketchup shamil karein aur ache tarhan mix ker lein.

steps.instruction: Add dark soy sauce and mix well.
steps.romanUrdu: Dark soy sauce dal ker ache tarhan mix karein.

steps.instruction: Add onion,tomatoes,capsicum,corn kernels and mix well for 1 minute.
steps.romanUrdu: Pyaz,tamatar,shimla mirch aur corn kernels dal ker 1 minute kliya ache tarhan mix ker lein.

steps.instruction: Add boiled rice and give it a good mix.
steps.romanUrdu: Chawal boiled dal ker ache tarhan mix ker lein.

steps.instruction: Add green onion,mix well & set aside.
steps.romanUrdu: Hara pyaz dal ker mix karein aur side per rakh dein.

steps.instruction: In bowl,add eggs,salt and whisk well.
steps.romanUrdu: Bowl mein anday aur namak dal ker ache tarhan whisk ker lein.

steps.instruction: Grease griddle with oil and heat it.
steps.romanUrdu: Tawa per oil laga ker garam karein aur pheetay hoye anday ko dal ker pheela lein aur halki ancch per dono sides sa paka lein.

steps.instruction: Pour beaten eggs,spread evenly and cook on low flame from both sides.
steps.romanUrdu: Bowl mein cooked omelet aur cooked chawal dal ker tamam sides ko fold ker lein.

steps.instruction: In a bowl,place cooked omelet and cooked rice & fold all sides.
steps.romanUrdu: Plate rakh ker carefully turn ker lein.

steps.instruction: Place plate over it and turn carefully.
steps.romanUrdu: Bowl ko hata lein,tomato ketchup aur hara pyaz sa garnish ker ka serve karein.

steps.instruction: Remove bowl and garnish with tomato ketchup,green onion & serve.

ogDescription: Omurice, a very tasty and different rice recipe for you today. We added out little touch of fusion to it and it came out just perfect. #HappyCookingToyou
